charts.title: growth-division-spatial-movie
charts.caption: Animated GIF of the 36-tick growth-division run: a single CPM cell (colored by cell id) on a shared 60x60 glucose field, growing as its per-footprint dFBA metabolism produces biomass, then splitting into two daughters via native divide_cells once it crosses vol_threshold -- visibly compounding into a small lineage of same-generation cells across the lattice as the run progresses. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.run_growth_division_frames` + `frames_to_gif` over the same run cited in this study's behavior tests, for provenance.

charts.title: growth-division-metrics
charts.caption: Interactive Plotly time-series panel of the same 36-tick run, synced to the GIF's time axis: n_cells and total_volume over the full run. n_cells steps up in a monotonic non-decreasing staircase (1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 8 -> 16) while total_volume tracks the compounding population -- the full grow-cross-divide-resume arc made directly visible. Re-baked directly via `meta_modelers_guide.cpm.viz.metrics_panel` over the same run as the GIF, for provenance. Interactive: hover for exact per-tick values.
